enchantment.enchanting2.withering.desc: Hits inflict Wither; arrows from a bow or crossbow too.
enchantment.enchanting2.poisoning.desc: Hits inflict Poison; arrows from a bow or crossbow too.
enchantment.enchanting2.freezing.desc: Hits inflict Slowness; arrows from a bow or crossbow too.
5% chance per level for a hit to deal 50% more damage.
enchantment.enchanting2.reach.desc: Reach blocks and mobs half a block farther per level.
enchantment.enchanting2.xp_boost.desc: 5% more XP per level from kills and mining.
enchantment.enchanting2.toughness.desc: Half a point of armor toughness per level.
enchantment.enchanting2.health.desc: Half a heart of max health per level, on each piece.
enchantment.enchanting2.cushion.desc: Less damage from flying into walls.
enchantment.enchanting2.vampirism.desc: A melee hit heals you by 4% per level of the health it took.
enchantment.enchanting2.beheading.desc: 2% chance per level that a mob you kill in melee drops its head.
enchantment.enchanting2.smelting.desc: Mined blocks drop smelted, with furnace XP. Silk Touch wins by default.
enchantment.enchanting2.true_shot_aura.d: Arrows fly straight, ignoring gravity, for 5 seconds.
enchantment.enchanting2.vision.desc: Night Vision while you wear it.
enchantment.enchanting2.step_assist.desc: Step up full blocks without jumping, like riding a horse.
enchantment.enchanting2.anchored.desc: 10% less knockback from hits per level. Explosions are Blast Protection's job.
enchantment.enchanting2.sure_footing.des: Soul sand and honey slow you a third less per level; at III not at all.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Less fire damage, and you burn for less time.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Less damage and knockback from explosions.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Less damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: 15% chance per level to hurt whoever hits you. Uses extra durability.
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc: Move faster underwater; full speed at III.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Water freezes under your feet as you walk. No damage from magma or campfires.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Can't be taken off until you die or it breaks.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Walk faster on soul sand and soul soil. Uses durability.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: More damage to spiders, bees and other arthropods, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping_edge.desc: Sweep attacks deal more damage. Only swords sweep.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Blocks drop themselves. With a pickaxe, mob spawners too, mob included, if the server allows it.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: More drops from natural blocks, never from placed ones.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Arrows aren't used up while you carry one. On a water or lava bucket, it never empties.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: The trident flies back after a throw.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you with it.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: Calls lightning on the target during a thunderstorm.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Smash attacks deal more damage per block fallen.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Smash attacks ignore some of the target's armor.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A smash attack launches you back up into the air.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: XP you pick up repairs the item.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: A spear's piercing attack lunges you forward. Costs hunger.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.protection: Stops adding at 20: all armor enchantment protection caps at 20 points (80% less damage), and Protection gives 1 point per level on each piece.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.fire_prote: Stops adding at 10: 2 points per level toward the 20-point protection cap. Burning time is gone from VII.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.blast_prot: Stops adding at 10: 2 points per level toward the 20-point protection cap. Explosion knockback is gone from VII.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.projectile: Stops adding at 10: 2 points per level toward the 20-point protection cap.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.feather_fa: Stops adding at 7: 3 points per level toward the 20-point protection cap.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.aqua_affin: Stops adding at 25. I already mines at land speed underwater; past that you mine faster underwater than on land, up to the game's cap at XXV.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.thorns: Stops adding at 7: 15% per level, so VII always triggers.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.depth_stri: Stops adding at 3: III is already full speed underwater.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.frost_walk: Stops adding at 14: the freezing radius is capped at 16 blocks.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.swift_snea: Stops adding at 5: sneaking can't be faster than walking.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.looting: No ceiling. Very high levels drop hundreds of items per kill, which can lag a server.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.sweeping_e: No ceiling, but each level adds less: the sweep gets closer to the full hit and never reaches it.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.efficiency: Stops adding at 32: mining efficiency caps at 1024. A diamond pickaxe breaks stone instantly from VI; obsidian never breaks instantly.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.fortune: No ceiling. Very high levels drop hundreds of items per block, which can lag a server.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.lure: Can't go above 5: from VI on, fish never bite.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.riptide: Can't go above 7: a stronger launch trips the server's moved-too-quickly check.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.multishot: No ceiling: each level adds 2 arrows (II fires 5). Hundreds of arrows per shot can lag a server.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.quick_char: Can't go above 4: V would have no charge time at all.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.piercing: Can't go above 127: the game stores an arrow's piercing in a byte, so 128 and up stop piercing.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.breach: Stops adding at 7: 15% per level, so VII ignores all armor.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.wind_burst: Can't go above 14: a stronger launch trips the server's moved-too-quickly check.
enchanting2.ceiling.minecraft.lunge: Can't go above 13: a stronger lunge trips the server's moved-too-quickly check.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.critical: Stops adding at 20: 5% per level, so XX is every hit.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.reach: Stops adding at 122: reach is capped at 64 blocks (block reach gets there at 119).
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.toughnes: Stops adding at 40: armor toughness caps at 20. Four pieces reach it at X.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.health: No ceiling worth reaching: max health caps at 1024 (512 hearts).
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.cushion: Stops adding at 5: 4 points per level toward the 20-point protection cap.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.vampiris: Stops adding at 25: 4% per level, so XXV heals all the health a hit takes.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.beheadin: Stops adding at 50: 2% per level, so L always drops the head.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.anchored: Stops adding at 10: knockback resistance caps at 100%.
enchanting2.ceiling.enchanting2.sure_foo: Stops adding at 3: III already removes all the slowdown.
enchanting2.config.title: Enchanting 2
enchanting2.config.mode.edit_file: Editing config/enchanting2/%1$s, which the next singleplayer world you open uses. Saving keeps the previous file as %1$s.bak.
enchanting2.config.mode.edit_hosted: You host this world. Saving writes config/enchanting2/%1$s (the previous file is kept as %1$s.bak) and applies it now, for LAN players too.
enchanting2.config.mode.locked_unreadabl: config/enchanting2/%1$s doesn't parse, so in-game editing is off. Fix the file (the log names the error), then reopen this screen. In a world, run /reload.
enchanting2.config.mode.locked_newer_sch: config/enchanting2/%1$s was written by a newer Enchanting 2. It's shown read-only so a save can't drop settings this version doesn't know.
enchanting2.config.mode.server_read_only: This server controls these settings. They're read-only here; only the server's admin can change them.
enchanting2.config.mode.vanilla_server: This server doesn't run Enchanting 2, so vanilla rules apply.
enchanting2.config.mode.kept_on_server: This server keeps these settings in its own %1$s and doesn't send them. Only the server's admin can see or change them.
enchanting2.config.experience.enabled.de: Off: the full vanilla curve at every level.
enchanting2.config.experience.flatten_af: From this level on, every level costs the same number of points. 0 = a fixed cost at every level.
enchanting2.config.experience.fixed_poin: XP points each level costs once the curve is flat. 112 is vanilla's cost from level 30 to 31.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.silk_t: On: both can be on one tool. Off: vanilla, one or the other.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.mendin: On: a bow can have both, and both work normally. Off: vanilla, one or the other.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.protec: On: Protection, Fire, Blast and Projectile Protection can share a piece of armor. Vanilla's damage-reduction cap still limits the total. Off: vanilla, only one.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.damage: On: Sharpness, Smite, Bane of Arthropods, Impaling, Density and Breach can share a weapon, and every bonus that applies adds up. Off: vanilla, only one.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.riptid: On: a trident can have all three. Off: vanilla, Riptide can't go with Loyalty or Channeling.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.multis: On: a crossbow can have both, and both apply. Off: vanilla, one or the other.
enchanting2.config.allow_together.depth_: On: boots can have both, and both apply. Off: vanilla, one or the other.
enchanting2.config.costs.rename_cost.des: XP levels to rename an item at the anvil.
enchanting2.config.costs.repair_cost_per: XP levels for each material item used to repair at the anvil (e.g. each iron ingot). There is no growing penalty for repeated work.
enchanting2.config.costs.repair_combine_: XP levels to repair by combining two of the same item. Enchantments moved across are priced on top.
enchanting2.config.costs.maximum_operati: Anything costing more shows "Too Expensive!". -1 = no limit. Creative players are never refused.
enchanting2.config.costs.creative_free.d: On: creative players pay no XP levels or lapis.
enchanting2.config.curses.max_discount_p: Each curse on the item makes its enchantments cheaper. This caps the total discount from all of them.
enchanting2.config.curses.removal_min_co: Least XP levels to remove a curse at the grindstone. Otherwise it costs the discount the curse earned on the item's enchantments.
enchanting2.config.anvil.invalid_book_mo: Book entries the item can't take
Reject all: no result unless every entry applies. Apply valid: the rest stay on the book. Strip invalid: the rest are destroyed (the anvil shows which first).
enchanting2.config.table.treasure_requir: On: Mending and Frost Walker can only be picked at full power (15 bookshelves). Curses are never gated.
enchanting2.config.fortune.silk_fortune_: A tool with both. Silk wins: Fortune never multiplies a drop Silk Touch changed. Fortune multiplies silk: it does, on natural blocks only. WARNING: on ores that multiplies the ore blocks themselves, which are then mined again with Fortune (about 3.1x the ore at Fortune V, more if placed-block tracking is lost).
enchanting2.config.beheading.player_head: On: a player killed with a Beheading weapon can drop their head. Off: Beheading only drops mob heads.
enchanting2.config.smelting.silk_priorit: A tool with both. Silk Touch: nothing is smelted, the block drops as itself. Smelting: the silk-touched drop is smelted (an iron ore block becomes an iron ingot).
enchanting2.config.silk_touch.collect_sp: On: a Silk Touch pickaxe drops a mob spawner as an item that keeps its mob, and the break gives no XP. Off: spawners never drop, as in vanilla. Only changes new breaks.
Off: never offered at the table, never in loot, never sold by villagers. Items that already have it keep it, and it keeps working. Overrides the three below.
enchanting2.config.enchantments.table.de: Off: the enchanting table doesn't offer it. Which enchantments the table can offer at all is the enchanting2:offered_at_table tag.
enchanting2.config.enchantments.loot.des: Off: never on enchanted loot (chests, fishing, bartering) or on gear mobs spawn with. How common it is: loot_weight in enchantments.json5.
enchanting2.config.enchantments.trade.de: Off: librarians never sell it as a book, and villagers never sell gear with it. How common it is: trade_weight in enchantments.json5.
enchanting2.config.save_failed.not_edita: It can't be edited right now.
enchanting2.config.save_failed.refused_f: The file was written by a newer Enchanting 2.
enchanting2.config.save_failed.refused_u: The file on disk doesn't parse. Fix or remove it, then save again.
enchanting2.config.save_failed.failed: The file couldn't be written. See the log.
enchanting2.config.display.show_preview_: Show the cost breakdown beside the anvil, on servers running Enchanting 2. The tab on the anvil window toggles it too. Saved in client.json5, for this player only.
enchanting2.config.display.enchantment_d: Hold Ctrl over an item to see what each of its enchantments does, on any server. Off when the Enchantment Descriptions mod is installed, which does the same. Saved in client.json5, for this player only.
enchanting2.config.display.show_hint.des: Show a "Hold Ctrl for enchantment descriptions" line under an item's enchantments while Ctrl isn't held.

enchanting2.grindstone.status.not_availa: That pick no longer applies. Pick again.
enchanting2.grindstone.status.curse: Curses can't be extracted. Take the book out to cleanse it.
enchanting2.grindstone.status.only_entry: That's the only enchantment on this book.
